item.tib: drag po las kyi sbyin bsreg brnag pa mthar phyin khrog rlag rol pa
item.coloph: de ltar drag po las kyi sbyin sreg nyid/ brnag pa'i mthar phyin khrog rlag rol pa zhes/ gsang sngags las mtha' rno dbal thog mda' can/ dpa' gtum glogs (glog) myur phrin chog lag len 'di/ dmu rigs nyi ma'i ming can de dag gis/ bstan pa'i kha srung ched du brtsams pa yi/ bstan dgra dam nyams sgrol ba'i gshed mar shog bstan pa'i dpal kha mthu yi bsrung bya ba/ bstan 'dzin skyes bu rno ba'i mtshon cha yin/ shing phag zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin rtsub pa'i sa gnas zhing du sbyar ba'o//
